_comment: Merge these hooks into ~/.claude/settings.json to keep the claude<->tmux pane
map fresh. Without them the map only updates when tmux-resurrect saves (every
5 min by default), so a session started shortly before a reboot is missed.
Your real settings.json also holds permissions and project context and is NOT
versioned here — it travels in the machine-migrate bundle. This file is just
the portable fragment, and contains no secrets.
If ~/.claude/settings.json already exists, merge by hand: these go under
